title: Claiborne Pell, Jack Reed and Biden: a UFO lineage

tellings.quote: Claybourne Pel was this senator who was long into UFOs who's from Delaware.

plain: Claiborne Pell, whom Michels describes as a senator from Delaware long interested in UFOs, is said to start a line of UFO interest in the US Senate that runs on to the senator Jack Reed and to Joe Biden. Michels says this himself, without naming a source. If true, interest in UFOs has been handed down quietly among a group of lawmakers.
